{{Quote|Careful, my young padawan. The shadows hold great rage… constrainted, but so deep it might swallow you whole.|Khaat Qiyn|<ref name="DM1" />}}
'''Khaat Qiyn''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] [[Jedi]] who served in the [[Jedi Order]] in the [[Republic Era|waning]] [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. In the years leading up to the [[Invasion of Naboo]] she apprenticed [[Bairdon Jace]]. At some point the two briefly encountered the [[Sith apprentice]], [[Maul|Darth Maul]]. Later, together they fought in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]] as members of the [[Jedi assault team]]. She frequently used [[Form V]] of [[lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat|combat]].

==Biography==
===Jedi Career===
====A looming presence====
{{Quote|Steady yourself. Trust in the Force, always. These games… distractions… could cause your undoing my apprentice.|Khaat Qiyn, to Bairdon Jace|<ref name="DM1" />}}
[[File:KhaatBairdon-2017DarthMaul1.png|thumb|right|300px|Khaat Qiyn and Bairdon Jace on Coruscant]]
At some point prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo]], Khaat Qiyn and her [[Padawan]], [[Bairdon Jace]], were monitoring the streets of the [[Coruscant Underworld]]. Unbeknownst to them, the [[Sith apprentice]] [[Darth]] [[Maul]] was lurking in the shadows, watching them. As they traversed through the crowds of [[alien]] [[species]], Qiyn noted to her Padawan that she felt someone's presence watching them, to which he replied that he could sense it too, and that he felt cold. Qiyn then went on to warn Jace of how shadows hold great rage, so much so that it could metaphorically swallow you whole.<ref name="DM1" />

Jumping to conclusions, Jace suggested that their senses could be betraying them, as he was unable to see anything. Keeping cool and collected, Khaat Qiyn told him to remain steady, and to always trust in [[the Force]], while cautioning that such distractions could cause his undoing.<ref name="DM1" />

====The Battle of Geonosis====
By [[22 BBY]], tensions between the [[Galactic Republic]] and a rising faction known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] were growing at an alarming rate. After [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo]] narrowly survived multiple [[assassin]]ation [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|attempts]], it was discovered that the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] was behind it. [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] subsequently followed the Fett to the barren world of [[Geonosis]], discovering that the Separatists had been developing their own [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]], and contacted the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] about his findings. Moments after sending a [[hologram]], the [[Jedi]] was discovered and captured. [[Mace Windu]] then made the decision to assemble a [[Jedi assault team]], made up of over two-hundred Jedi to crush the [[droid]] [[army]] the Separatists had been creating and to rescue Kenobi as well as [[Anakin Skywalker]] and Amidala, who had followed Kenobi to the [[planet]].<ref name="AOTC" />

Khaat Qiyn, as well as Jace, were two of the many Jedi sent out to Geonosis, as part of the Jedi assault team. Upon arriving on Geonosis, Khaat Qiyn and the Jedi infiltrated the arena, and hid until the [[time]] was right. After Windu revealed himself to [[Count]] [[Dooku]], the leader of the Separatists, they deployed their newfound droid army, and so the Jedi revealed themselves. With thousands of droids in front of them, Khaat ignited her blue-bladed lightsaber, and alongside her fellow Jedi, she [[First Battle of Geonosis|engaged]] the droid army and began cutting her droid adversaries down one by one.<ref name="AOTC" />

As the battle raged on the droid forces began to overwhelm the Jedi with a large quantity of their numbers being shot down. Before they could be annihilated however, [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] arrived with a [[Clone trooper|clone]] [[Grand Army of the Republic|army]] and assisted in evacuating the remaining Jedi. With these reinforcements the Jedi spearheaded the invasion of Geonosis which would become the first conflict of the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Personality and traits==
Khaat Qiyn had black [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and tan skin. She believed that all Jedi should trust in the Force, or it would lead to their downfall.<ref name="DM1" />

==Powers and abilities==
Khaat Qiyn was able to sense the presence of the [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul|Darth Maul]].<ref name="DM1" /> During the [[First Battle of Geonosis]] Khaat utilized [[Form V]] to cut down her opponents.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

==Equipment==
In battle Khaat utilized a [[Color|blue]]-bladed [[lightsaber]]. She wore a set of standard [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]] most of the time; when in battle she removed her outer robe like many Jedi.<ref name="AOTC" />
